import os,re,json
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def get_comps(g,bg):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); seen=set(); res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                stack=[(i,j)]; comp=set()
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) or g[a][b]!=g[i][j]: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.add((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): stack.append((a+da,b+db))
                res.append(comp)
    return res

def get_comps(g,bg):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); seen=set(); res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                stack=[(i,j)]; comp=set()
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) or g[a][b]!=g[i][j]: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.add((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): stack.append((a+da,b+db))
                res.append(comp)
    return res
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    gi=G[nm+' input']; go=G[nm+' output']
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    C=get_comps(gi,bg); H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    ks=defaultdict(list)
    for id_,s in enumerate(C):
        rs=[r for r,c in s]; cls=[c for r,c in s]
        r0,c0=min(rs),min(cls); h=max(rs)-r0+1; w=max(cls)-c0+1
        k=tuple(tuple(1 if (r0+r_,c0+c_) in set(s) else 0 for c_ in range(w)) for r_ in range(h))
        ks[k].append(id_)
    print('===%s'%nm)
    for k,vv in sorted(ks.items(), key=lambda kv:(len(kv[0]),kv[0])):
        mark='DUP' if len(vv)>1 else '  '
        print(mark,'shape size',len(k),' | cols:{')
        for i in vv:
            s=C[i]
            rs=[r for r,c in s]; cls=[c for r,c in s]
            col=gi[min(rs)][min(cls)]; sz=len(s)
            te=(min(rs)==0 or max(rs)==H-1 or min(cls)==0 or max(cls)==W-1)
            dsum=sum(1 for r,c in s if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c])
            print('   %2d col=%2d sz=%2d te=%s changed=%d'%(i,col,sz,te,dsum))
        print('}')

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g,bg):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); seen=set(); res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                col=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; comp=set()
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) or g[a][b]!=col: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.add((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): stack.append((a+da,b+db))
                res.append(comp)
    return res
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    gi=G[nm+' input']; go=G[nm+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # simpler: list components with their properties
    print('=== %s'%nm,'bg=%d'%(bg))
    for s in sorted(C,key=str):
        col=gi[min(r for r,c in s)][min(c for r,c in s)]
        te=(min(r for r,c in s)==0 or max(r for r,c in s)==H-1 or min(c for r,c in s)==0 or max(c for r,c in s)==W-1)
        ch=sum(1 for r,c in s if go[r][c]!=gi[r][c])
        if ch>0 or len([1 for s2 in C if s!=s2 and sorted(s)==sorted(s2)])==0 and any(True for _ in []): pass
        dup=len([s2 for s2 in C if s2!=s and sorted(s)==sorted(s2)])
        print('comp color=%2d n=%2d edge=%s changed=%d duppair=%d'%(col,len(s),te,ch,dup))

from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g,bg):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);seen=set();res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                col=g[i][j];st=[(i,j)];s=set()
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b]==col and (a,b) not in seen:
                        seen.add((a,b));s.add((a,b))
                        for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): st.append((a+da,b+db))
                res.append(s)
    return res
def norm(cells):
    rs=[r for r,c in cells];cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0=min(rs);c0=min(cs);h=max(rs)-r0+1;w=max(cs)-c0+1
    return tuple(tuple(1 if (rr,cc_) in set(cells) else 0 for cc_ in range(w)) for rr in range(h))
def solve(gi):
    go=[r[:] for r in gi];H=len(gi);W=len(gi[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    C=comps(gi,bg)
    grp=defaultdict(list)
    for s in C:
        grp[norm(s)].append(s)
    # duplicate-shape groups (size>=2); pick largest group / the one with members different sizes
    cand=[(k,v) for k,v in grp.items() if len(v)>=2]
    target=None
    if len(cand)==1:
        kk,v=cand[0]
        def inner_(s): return min(r for r,c in s)>0 and max(r for r,c in s)<H-1 and min(c for r,c in s)>0 and max(c for r,c in s)<W-1
        inter=[s for s in v if inner_(s)][0]
        tgt_c={go[r][c] for r,c in inter if go[r][c]!=gi[r][c]}  # check after? unknown. instead pick by size: recolor smaller/inner
        # decide: the one NOT touching any border
        for s in v:
            if not inner_(s) and (len(s)<len(inter) or (not inner_(inter) and False)):
                pass
        # simpler: recolor the inner one if exactly one is interior; else the larger
        si=[s for s in v if not any(min(r for r,c in s)==0 or max(r for r,c in s)==H-1 or min(c for r,c in s)==0 or max(c for r,c in s)==W-1 for _ in [0])][-1]
        # just: recolor smaller comp
        si=min(v,key=lambda s:len(s))
    else:
        # use largest group
        kk,maxv=max(cand,key=lambda kv:len(kv[1]))
        v=maxv
        si=min(v,key=lambda s:len(s))
    so=[s for s in v if s!=si][0]
    # source: unique-color comp (color count==1 across all comps) closest to so
    colcnt=Counter(gi[next(iter(s))[0]][next(iter(s))[1]] for s in C)
    src=None;b=-1
    best=min(abs(a-b2)+abs(cr-cd) for a,b2 in si for cr,cd in so)
    # candidate sources: comps not in v
    cands=[(min(abs(a-x)+abs(c-y) for a,x in si for c,y in oth),oth,gi[next(iter(oth))[0]][next(iter(oth))[1]])
           for oth in C if oth not in v]
    cands.sort()
    predsrc=cands[0][2]
    # recolor si to predsrc
    for r,c in si: go[r][c]=predsrc
    return go
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    gi=G[nm+' input'];go=G[nm+' output']
    p=solve(gi)
    print(nm, p==go)
    if p!=go:
        for r in range(len(gi)):
            if p[r]!=go[r]: print(' '.join(map(str,p[r])), ' vs ', ' '.join(map(str,go[r])))
